source.title: HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001488_1750_001752_1750_U02 (Gale crater layered outcrop), version 2.0
source.credit: Image: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona (HiRISE DTM, public domain); DTM produced with ISIS and SOCET SET (USGS Astrogeology)

vertical.datumOrReference: Meters above the martian equipotential surface (Mars 2000 Datum) defined by Smith et al. (2001); products tied to MOLA elevations (label IMAGE.NOTE; provider README)

limitations: Provider lists possible DTM artifacts: processing boxes (~0.5–1 m steps), CCD seams, faceted low-contrast areas.
Registration verified within the provider frame (stereo parallax 0.20 m RMS); absolute position versus other Mars datasets is not tested.

registration.method: NCC of the display crop (averaged to 1.0117 m) against the provider 1 m orthoimage on the DTM grid; 16 independent tiles
registration.residualSummary: Ortho-to-ortho: 0.59 m RMS / 0.73 m max. Independent stereo parallax (R1b): 36 points, 0.20 m RMS / 0.36 m max.
registration.toleranceSummary: Draft contract §1.4: RMS ≤ 1 cell, max ≤ 2 cells — both checks pass.

acquisition.processingHistory: SOCET SET NGATE extraction, 1 m posts, tied to MOLA (USGS Astrogeology / University of Arizona)
